'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Kristoffer Basse Hedlund DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kristoffer Basse Hedlund]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kristoffer Basse Hedlund]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Username:''' RegularOrdinarySwedish
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
